comparison.objective: Install a bracket, versus shim a door jamb.
comparison.physical_skill: Rigid bracket registration/latching versus opposed insertion of tapered wedges with force balance to close a gap without bowing.
comparison.success_condition: Bracket retained and clear versus paired shims snug after release within jamb-bow and alignment limits.
comparison.reason: Opposed wedging and compliance/force balancing are materially different.
